title: EU regulatory framework for AI - European Commission
snippet: The Commission's impact assessment estimates compliance costs for SMEs deploying limited-risk AI systems will be significantly lower than for high-risk system providers, which may face costs exceeding EUR 200,000 for third-party conformity assessments.

title: EU AI Act SME Compliance Guide - IAPP
snippet: Practical compliance cost estimates for SMEs range from EUR 25,000 to 50,000 for initial setup, with annual maintenance costs of EUR 5,000 to 15,000 for limited-risk systems. High-risk providers face substantially higher costs.

title: EU AI Act - European Commission
snippet: The AI Act includes provisions to reduce compliance burden for SMEs, including simplified documentation requirements and access to regulatory sandboxes to support innovation.
